overhead_service_share.label: Overhead power line
overhead_service_share.detail: This part of your line is mostly overhead, which is more exposed to wind, ice and falling trees.

log_customers_behind.label: Large shared segment
log_customers_behind.detail: Many homes share this segment, so a single fault here affects a wide area.

is_recloser.label: Recloser on your line
is_recloser.detail: This segment is protected by a recloser, which retries after a temporary fault.

is_fuse.label: Fuse on your branch
is_fuse.detail: Your branch is protected by a fuse, which can't reset itself after a fault.

is_automated.label: Automated protection
is_automated.detail: This segment has automated switching that can isolate faults.

is_pad_mounted.label: Pad-mounted transformer
is_pad_mounted.detail: Your transformer is pad-mounted rather than pole-mounted.

is_three_phase.label: Three-phase equipment
is_three_phase.detail: Three-phase segments tend to carry more load and equipment.

pole_mean_age.label: Older poles nearby
pole_mean_age.detail: Poles on this segment are older on average, which can mean more storm damage.

pole_share_old.label: Many poles over 50 years
pole_share_old.detail: A large share of poles on this segment are over 50 years old.

pole_wood_share.label: Mostly wood poles
pole_wood_share.detail: Wood poles are more likely to fail in a severe storm than steel or fiberglass.

pole_age_known.label: Pole-age data coverage
pole_age_known.detail: How much of the pole-age data is known for this segment.

zone_transformers.label: Large protection zone
zone_transformers.detail: This zone feeds many transformers, so a zone fault reaches many homes.

hist_damage_other_events.label: Storm damage here before
hist_damage_other_events.detail: This segment was damaged in other storms in the record.
